program.name: Swift Agent — Management Auth Hardening
program.description: Server-side companion to console-identity-readiness: explicit Cognito token_use validation, a legible auth error taxonomy, and route-protection contract tests for /v1/management/*.

companionProgram.relationship: Primary program. Consumes this program's token contract; its WS-02 depends on WS-19.

packages.name: @swiftagent/api
packages.description: Cognito JWT auth middleware, /v1/management/* routes, and buildApp-level contract tests (extends existing package)

successCriteria.description: cognito-auth.ts explicitly asserts token_use === 'id' and rejects other values with a distinct, accurate error.
A Cognito access token is rejected at /v1/management/* with 401; a valid ID token is accepted with 200, both asserted by tests.
Auth failures are distinguishable (missing header / missing token / wrong token type / invalid or expired) while preserving the HTTP status contract.
The route-protection matrix (401 unauthenticated, 200 valid, 401 access token, 403 cross-workspace) is covered by automated tests.
The accepted-token contract is documented in code/README for the site to reference.
pnpm typecheck and the @swiftagent/api test suite pass with the new tests (excluding pre-existing unrelated failures).

outOfScope: Any change to the marketing site (owned by console-identity-readiness)
New Management API endpoints or data-model changes
Rate limiting, API key rotation, audit logging
Cognito User Pool / Terraform changes (pool already exists from management-api WS-14)
Accepting access tokens or supporting both token types (contract is ID-token-only)
